_about: Free-text bridge target field (normalised: lowercase, trimmed) -> canon field id, or other:<name> for targets outside the 12 fields (KG phase 2, 2026-10-15). Policy: machine learning / deep learning map to llm (the llm canon's textbook strand covers them); statistics, probability, physics, mathematics etc. stay other:<discipline>; a concept name maps to the field of its canon spine entry or canonical instance. Texts not listed here fall back to keyword rules in build_kg.py.
